violations.why: The ISR can write v_pylon between two reads in the task, breaking atomicity.
The ISR can write v_pylon between a read and a subsequent write in the task.
The ISR can write v_pylon between the read and the write inside v_lantern.
The ISR can overwrite v_pylon after it is written in fn_lagoon but before it is read later in the loop.
The ISR can write v_pylon between the write in fn_lagoon and a later read in v_lantern.
